title: Implementation of Modular Depot Concept for Switchgrass Pellet Production in the Piedmont
content: Raw biomass (low bulk density) is converted to pellets (high bulk density) in several pellet depots. The distribution of these depots across the production area has impact of the total truck operating hours (raw biomass hauling to a depot + pellet hauling from the depot to the biorefinery) required to delivery feedstock for annual operation of the biorefinery. This study examines the distribution of depots across five production areas. The number of depots were 1, 2, and 4 depots per production area for a total of 5, 10, and 20 depots. Increasing from 5 to 10 reduced raw biomass hauling hours by 14% and increasing from 5 to 20 reduced these hours by 30%. Total hours (raw + pellets) were reduced less than 1% from 5 to 10 and about 11% from 5 to 20.
